mentions.name: TensorZero fork (LLMOps gateway)
mentions.description: An open-source fork of the TensorZero LLMOps gateway. The original project was archived, so this fork continues its development and keeps the LLM gateway open source, supported by six months of Codex credits dedicated to the project.
mentions.problem: The original TensorZero LLMOps gateway was archived, leaving it without continued development.
mentions.source_excerpt: TensorZero, LLMOps gateway, was archived yesterday and I forked it to continue development and keep it open source.
